text:
evan: quick triage - onboarding iris14b-int4 to p4d-canary. saw two transient alloc failures during a short burst of long-history chats. logs below.

mei: can you paste the runtime defaults used?

evan: used defaults from the app template: batch_size=12, max_new_tokens=480, prefetch=true, slab_cushion_pct=5.

sam: that pattern (prefetch + ~500 tokens + midsize batch) is a known frag hotspot on p4d. try conservative knobs: batch_size=6, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=false, slab_cushion_pct=10, slot_compactor=aggressive.

evan: patch applied and canary restarted. patch snippet:
```yaml
runtime:
  batching: { default_batch_size: 6 }
  generation: { max_new_tokens_default: 256 }
  prefetch_kv: false
  mem: { slab_cushion_pct: 10, slot_compactor: aggressive }
```

canary-bot: canary rollout requested by evan -> pool-p4d-canary (3 hosts)

mei: also cap kv_max_entries=1500 and set kv_trim_threshold=0.6 for the canary.

evan: ran 2k synthetic requests after patch: OOMs=0, p99 +28ms, avg stable. metrics: "ooms:0 | p99: 340ms | avg:130ms"

sam: looks stable. start a 200-prompt eval comparing int4->fp16 outputs at reduced max_new_tokens to confirm no semantic regressions.

evan: starting eval. early results: embedding-sim median=0.988, 3/200 minor format differences only.

mei: note for onboarding playbook - add model-catalog safe-defaults for quantized models and a frag-smoke preflight that ramps 0->25%->60% and checks alloc_fail rate.

evan: copying short log snippet to notes:
``
[2026-08-02T15:22:11Z] ERROR kv_alloc failed size=96MB reason=freelist_fragmentation
[2026-08-02T15:22:11Z] WARN slot_compactor: pass freed=30MB duration_ms=47
[2026-08-02T15:22:12Z] ERROR gen_worker: reserve failed for 48MB -> allocation failed
```

mei: great, leave canary open for 8h and watch tail latencies. :white_check_mark:
